annotations.title: Does an address hold a token?

description: Use before letting someone (or another agent) into something gated by a Bitcoin token or name, or before you try to sign in to a TOKENLOCK-gated site, to see whether a Bitcoin address holds that token right now. Free, read-only, no signature. Holds means the address owns the name/token or has a balance above zero. This is the same holding check TOKENLOCK runs at sign-in, but it does not prove the caller controls the address: for that, use start_token_signin/finish_token_signin (a gate pass) or create_challenge/verify_challenge.

address.description: Bitcoin address to check (bc1q, bc1p or legacy).

asset.description: Token or name on Bitcoin, e.g. GOTPROOF or PROVEITBOT.

name: check_token_access
